definitions.explanation: The record of when employees come to work, leave, take breaks, and are absent. Used in workplace management.

examples.japanese: {勤怠|きんたい}{管理|かんり}システムを{導入|どうにゅう}した。
examples.english: We introduced an attendance management system.

examples.japanese: {勤怠|きんたい}を{記録|きろく}するのを{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I forgot to record my attendance.

examples.japanese: {勤怠|きんたい}データを{月末|げつまつ}にまとめて{提出|ていしゅつ}する。
examples.english: I compile and submit my attendance data at the end of the month.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{勤|きん} (diligence, work) + {怠|たい} (laziness, neglect) - the kanji represent both working and not working, covering the full spectrum of attendance.

USAGE:
Business term for tracking:
・Arrival/departure times
・Late arrivals ({遅刻|ちこく})
・Early departures ({早退|そうたい})
・Absences ({欠勤|けっきん})
・Overtime ({残業|ざんぎょう})

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{勤怠|きんたい}{管理|かんり} - attendance management
・{勤怠|きんたい}{記録|きろく} - attendance record
・{勤怠|きんたい}システム - attendance system

RELATED:
・{欠勤|けっきん} - absence from work
・{出勤|しゅっきん} - going to work
